implementation.name: original-v3-workspace-overlay-visibility
implementation.scope: The original baseline panel becomes a live overlay: Task A writes code, then deletes data. File-level OverlayFS semantics; no block-copy or storage-volume claim.
implementation.question: How does a private edit change only one task’s view?

purpose: How does a private edit change only one task’s view?
guard: Copy-up is private; whiteout hides rather than mutates shared lower data. Copy-on-write is a storage mechanism, not by itself an execution isolation boundary.
